name: Berrit
title: Hearthmother
examine: Fed the whole village out of one pot through a winter nobody names. The long table is hers, and so, at supper, is everyone at it.
lines: Sit. Eat. Then tell me whatever it was.
The berry banks give more than they're asked. Take a pocketful, love.
Burnt your first bird? Good. The fire takes one as its fee, then you're taught.
